The Growth team has to sign off. They've owned the notifier since 2026-09-01. Post the copy change in **#growth-eng**, and any Growth engineer can approve it.

You may see older notes saying Dana Okafor has to approve notifier template and copy changes. That's out of date: Dana moved to Platform, and the team's project memory store already marks that note as replaced by the Growth team ownership note. There's no CODEOWNERS file or similar in the repo that says otherwise.

When you edit the template, update both files in `services/notifier/templates/`: the `.mjml` file and its plain-text `.txt` twin. They need to use the same snake_case variables, because some corporate mail gateways strip out the HTML version.
